markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Copenhagen Wolves" if Copenhagen Wolves win against FORZE Reload in the named Counter-Strike match.

This market will resolve to "FORZE Reload" if FORZE Reload win against Copenhagen Wolves in the Counter-Strike match.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
